# watchpoint_audit_webhook (Resource)

An audit-log webhook destination. The signing secret is returned only at creation; it is stored in state and never re-read from the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_audit_webhook" "example" {
  name = "Splunk SOC"
  url  = "https://siem.example.com/ingest/watchpoint"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the destination.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL audit-log events are POSTed to.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are active. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Webhook destination ID.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC signing secret used to verify delivered payloads. Returned only at creation and kept in state thereafter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_audit_webhook.example dest_001
```
